retrievalProfile.description: A dynamic 1970s action-themed collage featuring a full-length protagonist, explosive starburst effects, and secondary character vignettes.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a central figure in a dark trench coat holding a firearm, set against a smoky teal background with a bright yellow starburst emanating from the center. The right side contains a dense collage of secondary characters, gold records, and currency motifs.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure dominates the left vertical third
Starburst light rays connect the protagonist to the right-side collage
Secondary characters are layered in a bottom-right cluster
Typography is centered at the top and angled on the right
coreInvariants: High-contrast lighting on the main figure

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-length protagonist on the left at 80% height; secondary collage in the lower right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow starburst at the center-right focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the protagonist's weapon, along the light rays to the title and secondary character vignettes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Teal smoky atmosphere in the upper left and top center provides breathing room for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep teal and black (background and main figure)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow and white (starburst and highlights)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red and gold (typography and record discs)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the light effects against low-value, moody backgrounds.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Interlocking letters in the main artist name
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy red slab for the artist name paired with a dynamic, outlined sans-serif for the title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel of the title text.
Approximates the heavy slab-serif used for the artist name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s-style action collage. On the left, a man in a black leather trench coat and fedora holds a submachine gun. In the center, a bright yellow starburst explosion. On the right, a cluster of smaller character portraits, gold vinyl records, and US dollar bills. The background is a smoky teal and dark blue gradient.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in a heavy red slab-serif font at the top center. Add the movie title in a white, black-outlined, italicized sans-serif font at a 15-degree angle on the right side, overlapping the starburst.

verificationChecks: Is the starburst centered between the main figure and the collage?
Is the red text the most prominent typographic element?
Does the title text have a visible black outline and perspective tilt?

mustRedesign: Do not use existing movie titles
Ensure all currency is generic and non-reproducible
postGenerationChecks: Verify the starburst rays don't obscure the main figure's face
Ensure the red text is legible against the teal background
Confirm the collage elements feel integrated rather than pasted on
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast central figure with a central light source that bridges to a dense, thematic collage on the opposite side, topped with heavy, saturated display typography.
